processing: Read immutable author saved RDS; use in-memory HiCExperiment scores/interactions. Preserve 19667 records, 2103634 raw count sum, 200 contiguous 5kb bins and exact chr17 coordinates.

Author loop annotations cover chr17 beyond selected matrix. Filter score>=0.4 & qvalue<=1e-6 exactly (1639/2419), then native both-anchor overlap leaves31 visible loops; retain all2419 in provenance/plot_data with selection flags.
Heatmap score is balanced interaction frequency transformed log10; preserve limits[-4,-1.2]. Source squishes115 low and396 high records; neither drop nor reinterpret saturation as missing.
Native square plot mirrors record centers;39334 tile rows including doubled diagonal entries. Preserve upper/lower symmetry and source 1:1 physical data aspect.
Do not call import/refocus/zoom: RDS fileName points to an unavailable backing mcool; direct in-memory nativeplotMatrix needs no backing file. Do not run HiCool/getLoops/chromosight.
Current book deployment uses HiContacts1.15.2; pinned package source is1.15.3. Record version distinction and validate fresh native output rather than claim byte-identical publication output.

known_failures: OfficialSupplementS2F is yeast chrII O/E+Scc1, whereas this author-book target is humanchr17 balanced matrix; official figure-panel equivalence NOT_VERIFIED.
Book source snapshot/compiled image is2026 companion resource of2024 NatureCommun paper, not original2024 final assembly.
Backing mcool path is missing; safe loaded-objectplot only, no refocus/zoom and no arbitrary-input portability claim.
Loop qvalue filter is author-specific chromosight output; circle does not prove causal enhancer/promoter function.
Native code only draws loops when maxDistance=NULL; triangular auxiliary view would omit loop circles and constitutes a separately declared new layout.
Native palette clamps extremes; saturation is not sample-wise zscore or missing data.
Saved object uses old GenomeInfoDb Seqinfo class, so compatibility with current native packages requires explicit actual loaded-object QC.
Source rasterizes only matrix layer; text/loop circles remain editable vector; PDF must be inspected rather than assumed fully vector matrix.
